o.what: The 1965 federal law that bars voting practices that deny or abridge the right to vote on account of race or color (Section 2). Its preclearance formula (Section 4(b)) was held unconstitutional in Shelby County v. Holder (2013).

o.name: Religious Freedom Restoration Act
o.what: The 1993 federal law that bars the federal government from substantially burdening a person's exercise of religion unless it furthers a compelling interest by the least restrictive means.

o.name: Mental Health Parity Act
o.what: The 1996 federal law requiring large group health plans that cover mental health care not to set lower annual or lifetime dollar limits for it than for medical and surgical care; expanded by the 2008 Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act.

o.name: Election Integrity Act of 2021
o.what: Georgia's 2021 election law (SB 202): ID numbers for mail-ballot requests, limits on drop boxes, a shorter runoff period, rules for counting and for the State Election Board, and a ban on handing out food or water near voters in line.
